thread:
Mia Chen (CS): quick heads-up: Hummingbird Legal's demo is blocked in EU. Their corporate proxy NATs traffic to a couple small ranges. they asked for allowlist + temporary qps bump. renewal call in 9 days so high priority.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): pls paste the CIDRs and desired qps/duration. any residency pin?
Mia Chen (CS): CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.32/29. want eu-west-1 pinned. increase from 20 -> 80 qps for 72h around demo. data residency must remain in EU (using Private routing).
Asha Patel (Onboard): context: demo failed earlier when default burst protection tripped. customer nervous, renewal at-risk if demo flops again. can we set autorevoke after 72h?
Karl Ng (NetEng): we can add those prefixes to edge allowlist and tag with expiry. pin routing to eu-west-1. low-risk change, no maintenance window required. I'll apply with expiry metadata.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): note: pinning helps but watch control-plane callbacks. I'll set project routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 and ensure KV cache locality is favored.
Mia Chen (CS): ops snippet for the change (expiry RFC3339):
```
allowlist:
  - cidr: "203.0.113.0/28"
    note: "hb-legal demo temp"
  - cidr: "198.51.100.32/29"
    note: "hb-legal demo temp"
allowlist_expires: "2026-03-25T18:30:00Z"
rate_limits:
  project_id: "hummingbird-legal-prod"
  qps: "80"
  duration: "72h"
region_pin: "eu-west-1"
soft_limit: "120"
```
Asha Patel (Onboard): please add a slack reminder 24h before expiry and an autorevoke job. also tag CRM: "escalation-mitigated" if demo succeeds.
Karl Ng (NetEng): will do. creating change with tag `autorevoke:true` and expiry timestamp. adding firewall rules now.
ops-bot: Ticket CS-4521 created for change. assignees: Karl Ng, Jorge Alvarez. eta ~15m.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): set soft throttle at 120 qps as safety (not enforced unless infra constrained). autoscaler will still handle compute.
Karl Ng (NetEng): applied and smoke-tested from EU edge (simulated source ip). firewall logs show allow for both CIDRs. revocation job queued. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: CS-4521 status -> done. reminder scheduled for 2026-03-24T18:30:00Z.
Asha Patel (Onboard): customer reported demo success and low latency. marked escalation mitigated in CRM.
Mia Chen (CS): awesome. lowered renewal risk. i'll send a short post-demo survey to capture feedback on regional performance. :thumbsup:
